key_insight: WEST is an open-source, massively scalable excited-state simulation code that enables accurate quasi-particle, optical, and dynamical property calculations for systems with more than a thousand atoms.
engineering_relevance: For perovskite solar-cell and other materials workflows, WEST provides a practical path to predictive excited-state modeling on modern CPU/GPU supercomputers without explicitly computing virtual states.
method: Full-frequency GW, Bethe-Salpeter equation, and TDDFT in one framework
Density functional and density matrix perturbation theory with low-rank dielectric/exact-exchange representations
Hierarchical parallelization and GPU acceleration for near-ideal strong scaling
evidence_signal: The abstract reports representative applications and near-ideal strong scaling to thousands of GPUs, including simulations of systems with over a thousand atoms.
watch_item: Performance and accuracy depend on complex workflow integration and advanced HPC resources, which may limit adoption outside well-equipped computing environments.
paper_title: The WEST code for large-scale excited-state materials simulations
